name: Metemnecrosis
source:
As a Seer, your life's purpose is to cleanse the world of Necrocites and avoid being tainted by Necrose. In conjunction with your work, you must remain vigilant, pure of soul, and forever ready to take on whatever trial the Cathedral bestows upon you...

 How far are you willing to go to accomplish this?

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/metemnecrosis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名先知，你的人生目标是净化世界上的死灵岩并避免被死灵岩污染。在工作中，你必须保持警惕，灵魂纯洁，并永远准备好接受大教堂赋予你的任何考验……

 为了实现这一目标，你愿意走多远？

[来自[url=https://himebee.itch.io/metemnecrosis]Itch.io[/url]]
